evidence.quote: This is not a bug, because the tags for memos are embedded within the content rather than attached to the memo. Deleting a tag and changing the memo’s content would make it seem even stranger.
evidence.by: callmemhz (contributor); closed not_planned by johnnyjoygh (core maintainer)

confirmation.quote: Yes, I wish to only delete the specific tag from the list of tags, without deleting the content of the notes. ... Is it possible to fulfill such a requirement?
confirmation.by: ZDY321 (reporter) — reframes as a feature request

ambiguity: D: 'deleting a tag deletes the whole note' sounds like a data-loss bug; B: tag deletion may intentionally act on the memos carrying the tag. The report is one sentence plus screenshots.
decisive_code: server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go DeleteMemoTag: lists the caller's memos with the tag and, unless DeleteRelatedMemos is set, updates each to RowStatus Archived; web/src/components/HomeSidebar/TagsSection.tsx handleDeleteTag first shows window.confirm(t('tag.delete-confirm')) = 'Are you sure to delete this tag? All related memos will be archived.' (web/src/locales/en.json, zh-Hans equivalent).
notes: Memos are archived, not deleted, after an explicit confirm; weakest confirmation of the four (reporter reframes rather than explicitly agrees).

reviews.decidable_why: Source at v0.24.0 shows the explicit confirm text and archive-on-tag-delete behavior.
The v0.24.0 source (the confirm string and DeleteMemoTag) shows the behavior is intentional and warned about.
